entities.name: Proximal jejunal atresia
observations: Triple-bubble radiograph represents gas in the stomach, duodenum, and a dilated proximal jejunal loop; bilious emesis, distension, and failure to pass meconium support neonatal obstruction.

entities.name: Ischemic segmental resorption
observations: Classic mechanism of jejunoileal atresia is fetal mesenteric vascular disruption causing ischemia, necrosis, and resorption of the affected bowel segment.
This mechanism best fits proximal jejunal atresia rather than failed luminal recanalization, which classically explains duodenal atresia.
